notes: «أخيه الحسن» and «أخيه علي» give the name alone (rule 7); «علي» is an Imam written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator (owner ruling 2).
«عن أبيه» is a relation link; «أبي» at the start is a relation too, with no name.
«ص» and «ره» are blessings: left out. The Prophet's saying follows «عن النبي» and he is the end, not a link.
